newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: SABIC in contract to expand Saudi port facilities.
newsitem.headline: SABIC in contract to expand Saudi port facilities.

text.p: Saudi Basic Industries Corporation (SABIC) said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with the Saudi Ports Authority to build a berth and support facilities at the Red Sea port of Yanbu.
A SABIC statement said SABIC Terminal Services Company Ltd (SABTANK) would be in charge of construction and management of the facilities to handle and store liquid chemical products at the port.
It said SABTANK estimated the project would cost 338 million riyals ($90 million).

SABTANK was set up in late 1995 to manage SABIC affiliates' liquid product handling and storage facilites at the Gulf port of Jubail. The company became fully operational in 1996, the firm added. ($1 = 3.75 riyals)
